configure.title: Layisensi
configure.description: Mlingo wa layisensi ya kagwiritsidwe ntchito ka AI pa ntchito iyi. Onani https://dmd-program.github.io/aiul/ kuti mudziwe zambiri.

configure.title: Chosintha cha mtundu wa media
configure.description: Chosintha cha gawo la media chosakakamizidwa. Chimafotokoza mtundu wa media umene layisensi iyi ikugwira ntchito.

configure.title: URI ya AIUL (OER Schema)
configure.description: OER Schema: URI ya tsamba lofotokozera Layisensi ya kagwiritsidwe ntchito ka AI. Imadzazidwa yokha kuchokera ku ulalo wa layisensi ngati sinaikidwe.
